描述_EN: the wreck is now commonly referred to as the ca mau wreck. the wreck was discovered off the southern coast of vietnam in 1998 near ca mau. this date corresponds to the reign of the yongzheng emperor (1723-35). this object was salvaged from the wreck of a trade ship thought to be a chinese junk, dating to approximately 1725. this object is one of a group of 182 pieces of porcelain acquired by the v&a from this wreck. the ship was loaded with chinese porcelain of various designs for export to south asia and europe.
描述_ZN: 该沉船现在通常被称为CA MAU沉船。 该沉船于1998年在越南南部海岸附近的CA MAU被发现。 这个日期对应于雍正皇帝的统治时期（1723-35）。 这个物品是从一艘贸易船的残骸中打捞出来的，它被认为是一艘中国货船，可以追溯到大约1725年。 这件物品是V&A从这艘沉船上获得的182件瓷器中的一件。 这艘船装载了出口到南亚和欧洲的各种设计的中国瓷器。
